lines.text: The LORD loved Israel as a child and called His son out of Egypt, but they sacrificed to the Baals.
The LORD taught Ephraim to walk, led them with cords of kindness, lifted the yoke, and fed them.
Because they refused to repent, Israel would be ruled by Babylon, and a sword would flash through their cities.
The LORD asks how He could make Ephraim like Sodom and will not execute His full fury.
The LORD roars like a lion, and His trembling children come like doves and are settled in their homes.
